answer:
Mission Local reported that three friends arrived at the GameStop on Mission Street at 6 a.m. to wait for the release of “The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.” They brought folding chairs, snacks and laptops, and were first in line for the collector’s edition. About 10 other gamers joined them. The friends said they wanted a physical copy, calling lining up for games “a dying tradition.”

The story’s correction says an earlier version incorrectly called this GameStop the last one in San Francisco; there is another at Stonestown Galleria.
